exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.
availability.purchase: Installing one is a single deterministic purchase costing exactly two units of its assigned specialized material.

global_attack_rate_interaction.unaffected_timing: Movement threshold and Siege Anchor setup

rules.text: Moving less than 0.25M for 1.25 s replaces the forward ram with a circular barrier at 2.2M radius around the mech.
Crossing the barrier deals 150% current Damage, applies current knockback radially, and may affect a given enemy every 0.5 s.
Current ram width becomes barrier thickness. Moving 0.5M from the anchor point collapses it and another 1.25 s hold is required.
The branch converts an aggressive collision weapon into a high-output mining perimeter with a strict anchoring requirement.
